correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the necessary divisibility \(p^{\beta-1}\mid S_\alpha\) and parity of \(\beta\), then applies Chu's general Lemmas 4.2-4.4 at \(k=13\). The \(p\equiv1\pmod4\) branch is reduced to \(v\le4\); the \(p\equiv3\pmod4\) branch to \(v\le5\). The latter has a new exact finite reduction via \(t=(p+1)/2^{\alpha-v}\) and \(p\mid 2^{13v}-t^{13}\). The special \(t=2^v\) branch is handled by LTE and yields exactly \(\beta=2\). The supplied exact replay over-enumerates composites and confirms all remaining valuation bounds.
